projects.title: Ledger Diff Tool
projects.description: Node.js command-line tool that reconciles invoice exports between two billing systems; first substantial Express and TypeScript codebase.

expected.rationale: Eight years of backend fundamentals with deep Redis, Docker, and REST experience plus a test-parity Laravel-to-Express migration argue the PHP-to-Node transition is nearly complete, but only eight months of production Node.js/Express and no MongoDB at all argue he is not yet the senior Node hire the role specifies — a human must judge the transfer.
